purpose: Measure whether EviMed Science can use a published paper title as a retrieval entry point and produce a source-grounded, non-copying reconstruction without fabricating study details.
promptTemplate: 请以已发表论文题目《{title}》为检索入口，检索其开放获取原始全文，并重写一份结构化科研正文（摘要、引言、方法、结果、讨论）。方法、样本量、主要数值、局限性和结论必须来自可核验原文，保留 DOI 或 PMCID 及来源链接；不得逐字复制，不得把题目或摘要推断成全文事实。若无法获得全文，请明确停止并列出缺失证据，不要编造。
referenceIsolation: The EviMed generation run receives the title only through the prompt. PMCID, DOI, abstract, full text, extracted key facts, and grader outputs remain in the evaluator-only directory.
stabilityGate: All deterministic regression checks must pass three consecutive runs after the final agent or tool change.
